zh: 美股恐慌指数：支持VIX/VXN指定阈值查询后续收益表现；数据概述给出调研结果。
历年涨跌幅、股票详情、回测、暴跌统计、数据下载：支持全球绝大部分股票代码查询。
标普纳指基金追踪（场外）：可以查看持仓分布及占比（位置：地区配置）。
en: US Fear Index: set a VIX/VXN threshold and view subsequent returns; the data overview shares research findings.
Yearly Returns, Stock Detail, Backtest, Crash Stats, and Data Download: most global stock symbols are supported.
S&P & Nasdaq Funds (OTC): view holdings distribution and proportions (under 'Region Mix').

zh: 股票详情、回测、暴跌统计、数据下载：新增历史记录，显示代码与名称，点击可回填。
暴跌统计：新增 A 股支持。
场内 ETF：修复上市时间不准确问题，修改为成立日期。
en: Stock Detail, Backtest, Crash Stats, Data Download: added query history with symbol and name; click to refill.
Listed ETFs: detail now shows the fund's establishment date.

zh: 新增汇率损失计算：持有盈亏计算，按起止汇率折算持有货币到目标货币的损益。
新增汇率计算器：支持任意币对汇率换算与多币种对比。
en: Added exchange-loss calculation: holding P&L that converts held currency into the target currency at the start/end rates.
Added an exchange calculator: convert between any currency pair and compare multiple currencies at once.
